dct_description_sm:
This layer features the location of accessible features at City of Kingston facilities, including municipally-maintained parks, arenas, and buildings. Features mapped in this layer include accessible washrooms, parking spots, pathways, tables, benches, and splash pads. Accessible signage, audible traffic control, automated door openers, elevators, ramps, curb cuts, and pedestrian crossing locations are also included.

For more information about accessibility in Kingston, please visit the city's website.
